# kinsa-finalized-5seeds

10 runs, 2 configurations, seeds 42, 43, 44, 45, 46. Ranking `ranking-94b26df86d47`: US weight 0.2, admissions 1.0, ED 0.5. Lower WIS ratio is better; 1 = hub ensemble. Figures and table are regenerated by `planner rank`.
